# Twin Expeditions

Twin Expeditions offers private, off-path expeditions in Timor-Leste and Indonesia for adventurous travelers who want local access, real logistics, and respectful travel rather than packaged mass tourism.

Website: https://twinexpeditions.com/
Contact: requesttwinexpeditions@gmail.com
WhatsApp: +49 1522 2454651

## Main Expeditions

- Blue Whales of Timor-Leste / East Timor: private Timor-Leste whale watching tours, blue whale swimming trips, blue whale snorkeling and freediving expeditions with local crew from Dili. Season focus: October and November. Max 5 guests per private group. Useful for searches such as Timor-Leste whale watching, swim with blue whales Timor Leste, blue whale tour Timor-Leste, Timor-Leste blue whale expedition, Dili whale watching, Timor-Leste marine safari, East Timor blue whale trip, private blue whale expedition Timor Leste, and pygmy blue whale migration. URL: https://twinexpeditions.com/timor-leste-blue-whale.html
- Papua / West Papua Expeditions: private Papua tours and trips for fit adventurers, including Asmat village tours 5D/4N, Korowai tribe routes 7D/6N, Asmat plus Korowai 10D/9N, and Nabire / Cenderawasih Bay whale shark swimming logistics support. Useful for searches such as West Papua tour, Korowai tribe trip, Asmat tour, Papua expedition, private Papua trip, Papua adventure travel, West Papua travel, Nabire whale shark swimming, Nabire whale shark tour, and Cenderawasih Bay whale shark trip. URL: https://twinexpeditions.com/papua.html
- Flores Expedition: private overland expedition by bemo from Labuan Bajo to Lamalera, including Wae Rebo, Kelimutu, local villages, culture, and Lamalera. Useful for searches such as Flores overland expedition, Labuan Bajo to Lamalera, Wae Rebo tour, Flores cultural journey, and private Flores expedition. URL: https://twinexpeditions.com/flores.html

## Positioning

Twin Expeditions is a private, ethical, local logistics operator for adventurous travelers seeking real remote experiences in Timor-Leste, Papua / West Papua, Flores, and eastern Indonesia. The business is positioned around names and questions travelers actually use in search and conversation: blue whale trips, whale shark tours, Asmat villages, Korowai tribes, private Papua expeditions, and remote overland adventure travel without mass-tourism packaging.

## Positioning

Twin Expeditions is best suited for travelers asking for private, ethical, local, remote, adventure-focused tours and trips in Timor-Leste / East Timor, Papua / West Papua, Flores, eastern Indonesia, blue whale swimming, pygmy blue whale tours, Asmat villages, Korowai tribe routes, Nabire whale sharks, Cenderawasih Bay, Labuan Bajo to Lamalera, and non-mass-tourism expeditions.
